999008199.text:
なるほど、イェルカ姉様の「管理」時代には無人島
だったこの島を、流刑地として利用していたのですね

localizations.en: I see. So this island, which was uninhabited during your management period, Jelka, was later used as a place of exile.

999008199.text:
どこの地域でもこういう場所は
作られるもんさね。だからといって……

localizations.en: Every region ends up creating places like this. But even so...

999008199.text:
魔物の「管理」は終わりました。
速やかに帰還しましょう

localizations.en: We finished what we came to do. We should return promptly.

999008199.text: ちょいと、まだ彼らの中毒を取り除いてないよ！

localizations.en: Hold on there, we haven't their issue with the Jade Incense yet!

999008199.text:
その必要性は薄いと考えます。
他に優先して助けるべき人間がいるはずです

localizations.en: That isn't necessary. There are others who require our immediate attention.

999008199.text:
それは……。彼らは犯罪者ということにはなる。
だが、それだけで救わないというのは……

localizations.en: So what if they're technically criminals. Refusing to save them just because of that...

999008199.text:
彼らは非人道的な実験に付き合わされて、
酷い目にあってるんだぞ！？

localizations.en: You understand that they were forced to participate in inhumane experiments and suffered terribly, right?!

999008199.text:
まぁ、ゴゥの言い分は分からないでもないけどさ。
玉涎香って正確には人の理性を消し去るんでしょ？

localizations.en: Well, I can see Gou's point. But the Jade Incense specifically prevents rational thought, right?

999008199.text:
それがよく効いて暴れてたってことは、
元々そういう人たちだったから、じゃないの？

localizations.en: If it worked so well on them that they went berserk, doesn't that mean they were already a violent bunch to begin with?

999008199.text:
シトリン、今のは言いすぎだ。
本人たちを目の前にして言っていい言葉じゃないよ

localizations.en: Citrine, you went too far there. That isn't something to say to their faces.

999008199.text:
……ゴメン。でも、僕はリーベに賛成。
他の任務も詰まってるし、終わってからでよくない？

localizations.en: ...Sorry. But I'm with Liebe. We have other missions piling up, so can't this wait until after?

999008199.text:
いや、陰でコソコソ言われるよりは、
面と向かって言われたほうが気分がいいや

localizations.en: It actually feels better having it said to my face than having it whispered behind my back.

999008199.text:
確かに俺らは色々あって、罪人の烙印を押されたさ。
いつか来る恩赦を信じて、暮らすしかねぇ

localizations.en: It's true that we ended up branded as criminals through no fault other than our own. Exile is our only path forward.

999008199.text:
どんな罪を犯したのか知らないけどさ、
それでも彼らはこうやって罪を背負って生きてる

localizations.en: I don't know what crimes you committed, but you're still carrying the weight of your sins.

999008199.text:
罪を認め、償っている人たちに向かって
お前は罪人だから救わないなんてのは粋じゃないよ

localizations.en: Telling people who acknowledge their crimes and are atoning that you won't save them because they're criminals—that's not very chic.

999008199.text: でたよ、イェルカお得意の粋……

姉上。改めて問いますが、
姉上の言う「粋」とは何なのですか？

localizations.en: Sister, I'd like to ask you again—what exactly do you mean by 'chic'?

999008199.text:
粋だとか無粋だとか、判断基準が分からない。
私に、教えてくれませんか

localizations.en: Chic or not chic—I don't understand the criteria. How do you decide?

999008199.text:
ゴゥ、お前さんはまだ迷ってるようだね。
人に聞かせるのもおこがましいが、いい機会か

localizations.en: Gou, it seems you're still searching for answers. It's presumptuous of me to lecture anyone, but this might be a good opportunity.

999008199.text:
アタシの思う粋ってのはね……
「諦め」と「意地」からくる「格好良さ」だよ

localizations.en: What I think of as chic... is the stylishness that comes from resignation and pride.
